artboards.title: 6 - The callback: arrival spoken, both ways

annotations.text:
THE DOOR - realm 1 of THE AUDHDITIES CONDUCTING PLAN, step P.

Eight boards. Top row: 1 arrival at /sanctuary as a visitor, the Velkomin moment and the way to the door - 2 login - 3 signup with the felt "not now" on the acid-test offer - 4 forgot-password, both states. Bottom row: 5 reset-password, the recovery visitor - 6 the callback's failure spoken, on login - 7a and 7b the same door in the other theme.

Every board carries the ten-point sensory checklist on its right rail; KP's own ruling verbatim where a board embodies one; and every copy rewrite marked old to new with the file and line it came from. A gold dot means proposed - drawn plainest where the ground is silent, never landed as though it were ruled.

Colours are cosmic tokens only. Every contrast figure is measured, not estimated: the method reproduces HANDOFF.md's own 14.4:1 and 12.3:1 exactly.

Nothing in src/ was edited to draw this.

DECLINED - three alternatives considered and set down, each with the ground that declined it.

Kept on the canvas rather than deleted, because a design without its refusals is a claim with no reason attached - and because one of the three, the full-strength gradient ground, is what the door does today, so what was declined is also what is being changed.
